newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot gas softens in West, holds in East.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot gas softens in West, holds in East.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices on Monday eased in the West but held in the East as more supply became available in Alberta, market sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub slipped four cents to about C$1.45 per gigajoule, traders said.

"Field receipts are starting to show some reliability, and about 1.5 bcf (billion cubic feet) of storage went in over the weekend," one Calgary-based trader said, noting prices this weekend were as low as C$1.43.
July and July/October AECO were quoted at C$1.47-1.48 per GJ.
